instruction.description: User instruction for this slides task; always the highest priority.

title.description: Deck title for create; also the default file name. Optional — derive from instruction when absent.

style.description: Style skill id for create: japanese-style | soft-3d-clay | futuristic-tech-editorial | minimalist-luxury-branding | modern-illustration-editorial | japanese-hand-drawn-editorial. Optional — pick the closest style yourself when absent; explicit user style requests in instruction override the skill.

outline.description: Per-page titles for create (order = page order; first item is the cover). Optional — design it yourself when absent.

fileId.description: Target deck for edit: a file entry id or "active" (the deck currently open on the user's desktop). Defaults to "active".

roomId.description: Target room id injected by the gateway; binds the slides tools to the room. Required.

roomTitle.description: Optional room title for context framing.
